# DoughMath
> Browser-only bread, sourdough, starter feeding, dough scaling, and pizza dough calculators for baker's math in grams.

## Main calculators
- [Baker's Percentage Calculator](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/bakers-percentage-calculator): Convert between flour-based baker's percentages and ingredient weights.
- [Sourdough Hydration Calculator](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/sourdough-hydration-calculator): Split starter into flour and water to calculate total hydration.
- [Sourdough Starter Feeding Calculator](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/starter-feeding-calculator): Calculate seed starter, flour, and water for common feeding ratios.
- [Dough Scaling Calculator](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/dough-scaling-calculator): Scale bread or sourdough formulas by target dough weight, flour weight, or loaf count.
- [Pizza Dough Calculator](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/pizza-dough-calculator): Calculate flour, water, salt, oil, yeast or starter, and per-ball weights.

## Guides
- [Baker's Percentage Guide](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/guides/bakers-percentage): Explains flour-as-100% baker's math.
- [Total Hydration vs Added Hydration](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/guides/total-hydration-vs-added-hydration): Explains starter flour and water in sourdough formulas.
- [Sourdough Starter Feeding Ratios](https://doughmath.ymirtool.com/guides/sourdough-starter-feeding-ratios): Explains 1:1:1, 1:2:2, 1:5:5, and similar feedings.

## Key facts
- Calculations run locally in the browser.
- There is no account system, recipe upload flow, or cloud recipe storage.
- Formula outputs are math references, not food-safety guidance.
